response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled Staff-level Individual Contributor with exceptional technical expertise in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and mobile platforms. However, the resume lacks any evidence of formal people management, which is a strict minimum requirement for this Level II Engineering Manager position. While he would be an outstanding candidate for a Staff IC role within an Engineering Productivity organization, he does not demonstrate the required experience with performance reviews, 1-on-1s, or full-time people leadership.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools, testing frameworks (TDD, Selenium), and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated mobile platform knowledge, including direct iOS development and building mobile device orchestration tools.
Strong track record of technical mentorship, organizing coding Dojos, and facilitating technical workshops.
concerns: No explicit experience in formal people management, team leadership, or conducting performance evaluations.
Lacks demonstrated experience in strategic mid-to-senior level organizational management or leading organizational change.
Career trajectory and resume focus heavily on Individual Contributor (IC) achievements rather than people leadership.
